1: // Simple Pixel Runner game
2: // Canvas with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return;
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   const W = (canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth || 800);
9:   const H = (canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight || 200);
10: 
11:   // simple sound helpers using Web Audio API
12:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
13:   function beep(freq, duration) {
14:     const oscillator = audioCtx.createOscillator();
15:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
16:     oscillator.type = 'square';
17:     oscillator.frequency.value = freq;
18:     oscillator.connect(gain);
19:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
20:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime);
21:     oscillator.start();
22:     oscillator.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration / 1000);
23:   }
24:   function playJumpSound() { beep(440, 100); }
25:   function playCrashSound() { beep(150, 300); }
26:   // ensure audio context is running after user interaction
27:   function ensureAudio(){ if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume(); }
28: 
29:   const player = { x: 50, y: H - 30, w: 20, h: 20, vy: 0, onGround: true };
30:   const gravity = 0.8;
31:   const jumpForce = 15;
32:   const obstacles = [];
33:   let obstacleTimer = 0;
34:   const clouds = [];
35:   let cloudTimer = 0;
36:   let score = 0;
37:   let gameOver = false;
38: 
39:   function spawnObstacle() {
40:   const size = 20 + Math.random() * 20;
41:   obstacles.push({ x: W, y: H - size, w: size, h: size });
42: }
43: 
44: // draw a rounded rectangle for player/obstacles
45: function drawRoundedRect(x, y, w, h, radius, fillStyle) {
46:   ctx.fillStyle = fillStyle;
47:   ctx.beginPath();
48:   ctx.moveTo(x + radius, y);
49:   ctx.lineTo(x + w - radius, y);
50:   ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + radius);
51:   ctx.lineTo(x + w, y + h - radius);
52:   ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y + h, x + w - radius, y + h);
53:   ctx.lineTo(x + radius, y + h);
54:   ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y + h, x, y + h - radius);
55:   ctx.lineTo(x, y + radius);
56:   ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y, x + radius, y);
57:   ctx.closePath();
58:   ctx.fill();
59: }
60: 
61: // cloud drawing helper
62: function drawCloud(cx, cy, scale) {
63:   ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
64:   ctx.beginPath();
65:   const r = 15 * scale;
66:   ctx.arc(cx, cy, r, Math.PI * 0.5, Math.PI * 1.5);
67:   ctx.arc(cx + r, cy - r, r, Math.PI * 1, Math.PI * 1.85);
68:   ctx.arc(cx + r * 2, cy - r, r, Math.PI * 1.15, Math.PI * 1.85);
69:   ctx.arc(cx + r * 3, cy, r, Math.PI * 1.5, Math.PI * 0.5);
70:   ctx.closePath();
71:   ctx.fill();
72: }
73: 
74: function spawnCloud() {
75:   const scale = 0.5 + Math.random() * 0.5;
76:   const size = 30 * scale;
77:   const y = 20 + Math.random() * 40;
78:   clouds.push({ x: W, y, scale });
79: }
80:     const size = 20 + Math.random() * 20;
81:     obstacles.push({ x: W, y: H - size, w: size, h: size });
82:   }
83: 
84:   function update() {
85:   // move clouds
86:   for (let i = clouds.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
87:     const c = clouds[i];
88:     c.x -= 2; // slower than obstacles
89:     if (c.x + 30 < 0) clouds.splice(i, 1);
90:   }
91:   cloudTimer--;
92:   if (cloudTimer <= 0) {
93:     spawnCloud();
94:     cloudTimer = 120 + Math.random() * 80;
95:   }
96:     if (gameOver) return;
97:     // player physics
98:     player.vy += gravity;
99:     player.y += player.vy;
100:     if (player.y + player.h >= H) {
101:       player.y = H - player.h;
102:       player.vy = 0;
103:       player.onGround = true;
104:     } else {
105:       player.onGround = false;
106:     }
107:     // obstacles move left
108:     for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
109:       const o = obstacles[i];
110:       o.x -= 5;
111:       // collision
112:       if (
113:         player.x < o.x + o.w &&
114:         player.x + player.w > o.x &&
115:         player.y < o.y + o.h &&
116:         player.y + player.h > o.y
117:       ) {
118:         playCrashSound();
119:         gameOver = true;
120:       }
121:       // remove off‑screen
122:       if (o.x + o.w < 0) obstacles.splice(i, 1);
123:     }
124:     // spawn obstacles periodically
125:     obstacleTimer--;
126:     if (obstacleTimer <= 0) {
127:       spawnObstacle();
128:       obstacleTimer = 90 + Math.random() * 60; // frames
129:     }
130:     // score based on time survived
131:     score++;
132:   }
133: 
134:   function draw() {
135:     // background gradient (sky)
136:     const skyGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
137:     skyGrad.addColorStop(0, '#87ceeb'); // light blue
138:     skyGrad.addColorStop(1, '#fff'); // near horizon
139:     ctx.fillStyle = skyGrad;
140:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
141:     // ground
142:     ctx.fillStyle = '#654321';
143:     ctx.fillRect(0, H - 20, W, 20);
144:     // background already drawn; no clearing needed
145:     // draw clouds
146:     clouds.forEach(c => drawCloud(c.x, c.y, c.scale));
147:     // player
148:     drawRoundedRect(player.x, player.y, player.w, player.h, 4, '#0f0');
149:     // obstacles
150:     obstacles.forEach(o => drawRoundedRect(o.x, o.y, o.w, o.h, 2, '#f00'));
151: 
152:     // score & game over
153:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
154:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
155:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + Math.floor(score / 60), 10, 20);
156:     if (gameOver) {
157:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
158:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
159:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
160:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
161:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', W / 2 - 60, H / 2);
162:     }
163:   }
164: 
165:   function loop() {
166:     update();
167:     draw();
168:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
169:   }
170: 
171:   // input – click or tap to jump
172:     canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', () => {
173:       ensureAudio();
174:       if (player.onGround && !gameOver) {
175:         player.vy = -jumpForce;
176:         playJumpSound();
177:       }
178:     });
179:   canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', e => {
180:     e.preventDefault();
181:     if (player.onGround && !gameOver) player.vy = -jumpForce;
182:   }, { passive: false });
183: 
184:   // start game
185:   loop();
186: })();

(End of file - total 186 lines)
